GX III Gold 1050
Introducing the GX III Gold, featuring an all-new material and
structural design with hexagonal details for improved airflow
and a cleaner overall look. This 80 Plus Gold and Cybenetics
Platinum certified unit can achieve Platinum level efficiency
at 20%, 50% and 100% loads in a 115V test.
The GX III Gold also features ATX 3.0 support, a durable
12VHPWR cable, a half-bridge APFC, LLC, and DC-DC design,
anodic-coated heat sinks that reduce average component
temperature by 5 °C, and an STCM zero-RPM fan. The GX III
Gold achieves excellent performance, efficiency, noise
reduction, and heat dissipation.
STRENGTH IN ELEGANCE
Fully modular cabling: Efficiently reduces clutter,
increases airflow, and improves overall efficiency and
thermal performance.
Innovative, streamlined design: An innovative
screwless aesthetic provides a cleaner appearance,
and the hexagonal fan cover improves air intake
efficiency.
10-year warranty: This unit comes with a standard
limited manufacturing warranty of 10 years from the
date of purchase.
